theorem mathd_algebra_313_affine (v i z : ℂ) (h₀ : v = i * z) (h₁ : v = 1 + Complex.I) (h₂ : z = 2 - Complex.I) : 5 * i = 1 + 3 * Complex.I := by
  have h : i * (2 - Complex.I) = 1 + Complex.I := by
    calc
      i * (2 - Complex.I) = i * z := by rw [h₂]
      _ = v := h₀.symm
      _ = 1 + Complex.I := h₁
  have hp : (2 - Complex.I) * (2 + Complex.I) = (5 : ℂ) := by
    calc
      (2 - Complex.I) * (2 + Complex.I) = 4 - Complex.I * Complex.I := by ring
      _ = 5 := by rw [Complex.I_mul_I]; norm_num
  calc
    5 * i = i * 5 := by ring
    _ = i * ((2 - Complex.I) * (2 + Complex.I)) := by rw [hp]
    _ = (i * (2 - Complex.I)) * (2 + Complex.I) := by ring
    _ = (1 + Complex.I) * (2 + Complex.I) := by rw [h]
    _ = 2 + 3 * Complex.I + Complex.I * Complex.I := by ring
    _ = 1 + 3 * Complex.I := by rw [Complex.I_mul_I]; ring
